description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the GenerateSuperResolutionImage operation in the image production (imageenhan) category
description_zh: 本文介绍图像生产（imageenhan）类目下的生成式图像超分GenerateSuperResolutionImage的语法及示例
name: GenerateSuperResolutionImage

parameters.help_en: The URL of the input image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS URL is not in the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 输入图片地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The image upscaling factor. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, and 4. Default value: 2
parameters.help_zh: 图像放大倍数。支持1，2，3，4，默认为2
parameters.name: scale

parameters.help_en: This parameter is a reserved field. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 该参数为接口保留字段，默认不需要填写
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The storage format of the output image. Valid values: `png`, `jpg`, and `bmp`. Default value: `png`
parameters.help_zh: 输出图像的存储格式。取值范围：`png`、`jpg`、`bmp`，默认`png`
parameters.name: output_format

parameters.help_en: The quality factor of the output image. A larger value indicates higher quality. Valid values: [30,100]. Default value: 95. This parameter takes effect only when `outputFormat` is set to `jpg`
parameters.help_zh: 输出图像的质量因子，值越大质量越高。取值范围[30,100]，默认95，仅当`outputFormat`为`jpg`时有效
parameters.name: output_quality
